Caveat for the merger: release-bump.sh also classifies body lines after stripping a leading '* '/'- ', so a squash body that carried this branch's 'feat(daemon): ...' commit subject as a bullet would bump to 1.18.0; none of the last 60 main squash bodies carries a conventional bullet (the merge queue writes the READY packet as the body), so the risk is only if the squash body format changes.
